purpose: Source-backed worked examples, not invoice measurements or production pricing overrides.
currencyPolicy: Compare native CNY with native CNY and native USD with native USD; no FX conversion.

workload.name: AInsights Coding Mix
workload.note: Shares of total billable tokens. Input excludes cache hits; output includes billed reasoning tokens. This is a scenario, not observed customer traffic.

sources.locator: Personal monthly/annual pricing tables; language-model credit consumption table; exhaustion and discount paragraphs
sources.facts: Lite CNY 39 or USD 6 monthly, 4.1B Credits. Personal annual Lite CNY 411.84, 49.2B Credits. Pro input/cache/output coefficients 300/2.5/600; Flash 100/2/200 Credits per token. Off-peak coefficient 0.8, 00:00-08:00 UTC+08. First personal monthly purchase 0.88; not stackable with annual discount. Exhaustion stops service.

sources.locator: Domestic and overseas real-time language-model pricing tables; billing notes
sources.facts: MiMo V2.6 Pro input/cache/output per million: CNY 3/0.025/6 and USD 0.435/0.0036/0.87. Flash: CNY 1/0.02/2. Batch is a separate service. Search calls are charged separately.

sources.locator: Plan explanation, pricing, point deduction example and migration sections
sources.facts: Lite CNY 40 monthly: Token mode 42M tokens or point mode 6600 points. Token mode deducts input/output/cache equally. Points depend on model, token type, reasoning and tools. The DeepSeek V4 Pro example is approximate: 853 input, 10240 cached and 427 output tokens consume about 1 point each, about 3 total.

sources.locator: Promotional notices and Lite point-mode price card
sources.facts: Lite first-purchase card CNY 19.9 vs CNY 40 list. First renewal during the activity is advertised at 60% of list. The product now offers both point and Token modes. Promotional eligibility and final checkout remain conditional.

sources.locator: Plan prices; every-seven-day limit definition; usage packs; Credits billing mechanism
sources.facts: Lite limited-time CNY 39/month, list CNY 60; 2500 Credits per seven-day window starting on first use in each window; unused Credits do not carry over. Additional pack CNY 100/month for 20000 Credits requires an active subscription. Request Credits depend on model, tokens, reasoning and tools, with console usage controlling actual debit.

creditCases.note: Annual fee already includes 0.88 discount. Amortized arithmetic does not establish when Credits are released or whether they roll over.

tokenCase.promotionNote: Promotional calculations are conditional on eligibility and the selected Token-mode checkout confirming this price; the freshly fetched product card defaults to point mode.

approximatePointCase.note: An approximate documentation example, not a universal model tariff. No extrapolated per-token offer may enter production rankings.

dynamicCreditCase.note: Window examples are conditional schedules, not a guaranteed monthly quota. A token-to-Credit formula is not established by the reviewed page.
